description: EV-05 golden SQL questions over the gold marts present in every build (fct_tenant_margin). Scored by execution result, not SQL text. `equivalent_sql` is a differently written correct query (checks the scorer accepts it); `wrong_sql` must score as a miss.

questions.question: Which 5 tenants have the highest total gross margin?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT tenant_id, sum(gross_margin_usd) AS m FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY m DESC, tenant_id LIMIT 5
questions.equivalent_sql: SELECT tenant_id, SUM(gross_margin_usd) AS gm FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY gm DESC, tenant_id FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
questions.wrong_sql: SELECT tenant_id, sum(gross_margin_usd) AS m FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY m ASC, tenant_id LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which 3 features have the lowest total gross margin?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT feature_id, sum(gross_margin_usd) AS m FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY m, feature_id LIMIT 3
questions.equivalent_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT feature_id, SUM(gross_margin_usd) AS g FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY feature_id) SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY g, feature_id LIMIT 3
questions.wrong_sql: SELECT feature_id, sum(llm_cost_usd) AS m FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY m, feature_id LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many distinct tenants have margin rows?
questions.equivalent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM fct_tenant_margin)

questions.question: What is the total LLM cost?
questions.equivalent_sql: SELECT SUM(llm_cost_usd) AS total FROM fct_tenant_margin

questions.question: How many requests did each feature serve?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT feature_id, sum(request_count) FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1
questions.equivalent_sql: SELECT feature_id, SUM(request_count) AS n FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY feature_id ORDER BY n DESC
questions.wrong_sql: SELECT feature_id, count(*) FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many tenants have a negative total gross margin?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT tenant_id FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(gross_margin_usd) < 0)
questions.equivalent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT tenant_id, SUM(gross_margin_usd) AS s FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY tenant_id) WHERE s < 0
questions.wrong_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT tenant_id FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(gross_margin_usd) <= 0 OR sum(gross_margin_usd) > 0)

questions.question: What is the AI revenue per month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', margin_date) AS DATE) AS mth, sum(ai_revenue_usd) FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
questions.equivalent_sql: SELECT strftime(margin_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS mth, SUM(ai_revenue_usd) FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
questions.wrong_sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', margin_date) AS DATE) AS mth, sum(llm_cost_usd) FROM fct_tenant_margin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many tenant-feature-days have a gross margin under 20%?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fct_tenant_margin WHERE gross_margin_pct < 0.2
questions.equivalent_sql: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fct_tenant_margin WHERE NOT (gross_margin_pct >= 0.2)
questions.wrong_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fct_tenant_margin WHERE gross_margin_pct < 20
